```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
library(GynRepanel)
```

## Overview

GynRepanel implements the three-paradigm integration benchmark for OV/UCEC/CESC
with undecidability classification per SPIRIT 2013.

## Example: TOST equivalence test

```{r tost-example}
set.seed(42)
x <- rnorm(50, mean = 0, sd = 0.01)
tost_res <- tost_equivalence(x, delta_equiv = 0.10)
tost_res$equivalent
tost_res$ci_90_low
tost_res$ci_90_high
```

## Example: four-way undecidable classification

```{r classify-example}
undecidable_classify(diff =  0.60, mdd = 0.466, equiv = -0.10)
undecidable_classify(diff =  0.00, mdd = 0.466, equiv = -0.10)
undecidable_classify(diff = -0.80, mdd = 0.466, equiv = -0.10)
undecidable_classify(diff =  0.30, mdd = 0.466, equiv = -0.10)
```
